title: DDToken
tagline: Combining growth hacking with self-sovereign identity in the DeFi world.
description:
The idea of DDToken is to be an on-ramp for Yearn.Finance and use ZKRollups to deposit directly into the $yETH & $yDAI Vaults.  This is a direct value add for users as it saves on gas costs while optimizing yield on $ETH & $DAI.

We aim to make the user interface as user friendly as possible.
how_its_made:
We are working on the implementation by linking Yearn.Finance’s Version 2 $yETH & $yDAI Vaults via Zapper with the Loopring Bridge.



We do not have a live product yet but we view this as only the beginning and yesterday applied for the Filecoin / IPFS Accelerator as well.



We still need to work on further integration with IPFS.
